analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.statement: x and y lie on the positive real axis, where the scalar principal square root is smooth and single-valued.

branch_conventions: sqrt denotes the nonnegative scalar square root on (0, infinity).

function_domains.sqrt: Unique positive scalar square root on (0, infinity); no complex branch is used.

nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.statement: x and y are distinct, so y-x is nonzero.

nonzero_conditions.label: DERIVED
nonzero_conditions.statement: sqrt(x)+sqrt(y) is strictly positive and hence nonzero.

real_valued_functions: sqrt is real-valued and positive on (0, infinity)
